### Added

- *(workspaces)* Pin workspace-manager to the provider App in muster in [#1090](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1090) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(muster)* Run two replicas spread over nodes behind minAvailable: 1 in [#1081](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1081) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* A Session's provider hosts get the person's token from muster in [#1088](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1088) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(workspaces)* Derive muster's issuer from the github instance's App id in [#1092](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1092) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(migrate)* Cover the Organization namespaces with the migrate run in [#1091](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1091) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Floor muster at 5.44.0 and workspace-manager at 0.10.0 in [#1097](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1097) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(verify)* Hold the goldens to the branch's merge-base with main in [#1098](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1098) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
